units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“无论如此或如彼，尽是前世果报。

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "Whether things are this way or that, it is all the result of karma from a former life.

units.source_text: 推究其源，不外咎由自取。

en.t: If one traces it back to its source, it is nothing other than blame brought upon oneself.

units.source_text: 身无官爵之人，虽小犯过失，亦当受朝廷处分。

en.t: Even a person without rank or office, if he commits the smallest fault, must be punished by the court.

units.source_text: 若不自惩，而与常人共处世中，在外国亦认为非法。

en.t: If he does not punish himself and simply lives among ordinary people, even in foreign lands this would be considered unlawful.

units.source_text: 而似我身居高位之人，听说尚有流放远恶军州之定例。

en.t: And for someone like me, who holds a high position, I hear there is even a fixed rule of exile to a distant and harsh military province.
The penalty I must accept should naturally be still heavier.

units.source_text: 若自谓问心无愧，而泰然自若，深恐后患甚多，

en.t: If I were to say that my conscience is clear and remain perfectly calm, I deeply fear there would be many troubles afterward,

units.source_text: 或将身受更大之耻辱，亦未可知。

en.t: and it is impossible to know whether I might suffer an even greater disgrace myself.

units.source_text: 我为防患未然之计，故而先行离京耳。”

en.t: So, as a way to prevent disaster before it happens, I am leaving the capital first."

units.source_text: 他把离京赴须磨的情由详细禀告了左大臣。

en.t: He explained in detail to the Minister of the Left the reasons for leaving the capital and going to Suma.
